research_question: What observable outputs and project-level changes follow when an Okinawa civic action enters a formal institutional venue?
actor_universe_rule: Fixed initial frame of the 13 translation episodes already assembled in translation_episode_comparison_v1; actor identity and role remain case-specific
place_scope: Okinawa with Japanese, U.S. and international venues reached from Okinawa cases
source_family_scope: official court/administrative/legislative/referendum records;formal submissions;project-control sources;existing human-reviewed project sources
inclusion_rule: Episode has a documented attempt to enter a formal venue and an observable institutional output; retain TE10-TE13 as pending event-fact candidates rather than silently dropping them
exclusion_rule: Pure public statement without documented venue entry; actor-issue co-occurrence; event-only participation treated as alliance; duplicate procedural stages of the same episode
search_completion_status: fixed_input_frame_13;9 reviewed/accepted process episodes;4 analytic candidate events pending
authority_requirement: Each coded outcome must resolve to an official decision, court record, formal administrative/legislative record or project-control document; the existing source IDs remain provenance only until the W2-C field review
negative_claim_eligibility: no; ENTRY and RECORD are selection conditions and cannot support a success rate
notes: Initial positive-entry frame, not a census of all Okinawa civic action. Existing underlying_change values must be recoded to parallel axes before interpretation.

research_question: Which comparable Okinawa civic actions did not obtain entry to, or a record from, the same formal venues represented in the positive-entry frame?
unit_of_analysis: attempted action x intended institutional venue
actor_universe_rule: Search slots matched to the route families, places, periods and action types in USF-W2C-ENTRY13; no target count is forced when no defensible match exists
place_scope: Same places and institutional venue families as the positive-entry frame
source_family_scope: court dockets and dismissal orders;assembly/council minutes;administrative receipt/rejection records;referendum ordinances and election records;formal international-institution records
inclusion_rule: Documented attempt directed at a competent venue that was refused, dismissed before substantive admission, blocked at a formal gate, or produced no institutional record after a bounded official-source search; match on route, place, period and action type where possible
exclusion_rule: No evidence of an attempted entry; media-only advocacy; an episode already in the positive frame; absence inferred solely from the project database; unmatched historical anecdote
authority_requirement: At least one authoritative record of the attempt/gate, plus a bounded negative-search log for the expected venue record; unavailable records remain unresolved
negative_claim_eligibility: no until matched cases, symmetric source coverage and principal review are complete
notes: Suggested search strata: international/legal, EIA/administrative comment, noise litigation, public-funds litigation, referendum/ordinance, local administrative petition and labor/assembly action.

research_question: Do official project records contain counterexamples in which scope, location, timing, budget or authority changed, and what level of attribution to civic action is documented?
actor_universe_rule: Search all project axes represented by the 13 entry episodes plus matched official project records; include both attributed and clearly non-attributed changes as competing explanations
place_scope: Henoko/Oura Bay;Kadena;Futenma;Awase;Ishigaki;Yonaguni;Miyako and any directly matched project locality
source_family_scope: official project plans and change approvals;budget and expenditure tables;court/administrative orders;official implementation timelines;formal causation statements
inclusion_rule: Official record shows a change in PROJECT_SCOPE, PROJECT_LOCATION, PROJECT_TIMING, PROJECT_BUDGET or PROJECT_AUTHORITY; preserve action, decision, time order and attribution evidence separately
exclusion_rule: Only rhetoric or media speculation; a technical/budget change automatically attributed to NGO action; monetary award to counsel treated as project change; missing project record treated as no change
authority_requirement: Official before/after project or decision record; attribution is coded independently and may remain none/contested/unknown
negative_claim_eligibility: no until all five axes receive bounded official-source searches and attribution candidates receive principal review
notes: The 2019 Henoko plan/cost revision is an immediate non-NGO-attributed comparator; TE06 Awase must be split by litigation wave before any project-change claim.
